tasks.title: Separate stock and ETF architecture with replaceable ML
tasks.why: Historical stock YetiRank, ETF strategy, data processing, simulation, and unfinished execution paths were coupled and lacked explicit asset boundaries.
tasks.resolution: Introduced explicit core asset contracts, isolated stocks and etfs packages, point-in-time ML dataset/split/artifact boundaries, ETF parity fixtures, and paper-only execution gates; aligned filters tests and quality tooling with the migration boundary.
tasks.impact: Research and simulation paths are structurally separated; legacy modules remain excluded/read-only during migration, and live order submission remains gated.
